turns.assessment: The simultaneous ~5.3 dB drops in received power and estimated OSNR are confined to och88 at S21, while upstream channel and amplifier telemetry remained unchanged. That localizes the loss after the incoming OCM and before the receiver, most consistently to channel-specific WSS attenuation at S21; recent maintenance there adds supporting context. A receiver-local defect is possible but less consistent with a real power reduction and unchanged pre-FEC BER.

proposals.rationale: A channel-specific attenuation increase in the S21 WSS would reduce och88 power after the incoming channel monitor, explaining why trx.och88.z alone reports a ~5.3 dB loss while upstream OCM and amplifier measurements remain stable.
proposals.note: site named; resolved to its node equipment

proposals.rationale: A receiver-local measurement or optical-front-end degradation could produce changes only at this receiver, but the matched power and OSNR reductions without BER change make it less likely than actual local WSS attenuation.
A shifted passband could affect only och88 locally, but its documented signature is reduced quality with normal power, contrary to the measured 5.3 dB power drop.

clarify.assessment: The monitored path for och88 toward its S21 receiver traverses S08→S24→S18→S19→S21, so it enters S21 on the S19-S21 degree. Therefore the implicated S21 channel-specific WSS location is oms.S19-S21|16; the S10 and S06 incoming degrees are not on och88's arriving path.
